approved_by: Jaden (repository owner): in-session reply 'ok apply' on 2026-10-05 approving the source-supersession patch and this bindings file
purpose: The protected spec cites URLs that cannot be archived (dead, blocked, mirrors, distributor pages) and local paths from the authoring workspace. Supersessions point each unarchivable URL to a primary document that was opened and checked; artifact bindings lock the repository files a local reference means. Fetch receipts prove bytes, not support: every supersession states what it supports, and partial or conflicting ones explain the gap.
